根据歌词行数/字号自动调整窗口高度；拖动窗口边缘会切换为手动高度: Sizes the window from the lyric options; dragging the window edge switches to manual height
也可以直接拖动迷你播放器窗口边缘调整大小: You can also drag the mini player window edge to resize it
独立窗口可放在另一台显示器；窗口模式下可拖动边缘调整大小，尺寸和位置会记住；F1: The standalone window can be placed on another display; in windowed mode drag its edge to resize and the size/position are remembered; F11 toggles fullscreen/windowed
歌词显示当前/后续行；普通 LRC 也会按时渐变，逐字高亮需要带时间轴的歌词；窗: Shows the current/following lines; plain LRC also fills by timing, word-by-word highlighting needs timed lyrics. The window height adjusts automatically
普通 LRC 也会按行时间平滑渐变；开启“仅增强型 LRC”后只对带逐字时间轴的: Plain LRC also fills smoothly by line timing; with “Enhanced LRC only” the fill applies only to lyrics with word timings
仅当歌词包含 <mm:ss.xx> 逐字时间时启用逐字填充；关闭时普通 LRC: Word-by-word fill only when lyrics contain <mm:ss.xx> timings; when off, plain LRC also fills proportionally
选择一个音乐目录后可按文件夹浏览；大目录不会一次性扫描: Choose a music folder to browse it; large folders are not scanned all at once
选择后加入队列并播放: Add to the queue and play after selection

没有动画时（仅播放进度与时间）的刷新频率；降低可显著减少前台 CPU/GPU 唤: Refresh rate when nothing animates (progress and time only); lowering it greatly reduces foreground CPU/GPU wake-ups
关闭后背景图保持不变，不再为动画重绘: Keeps the background still and stops animation repaints
动效帧率；30 fps 已足够平滑，降低可减少 GPU 占用: Animation frame rate; 30 fps is smooth enough and lowering it reduces GPU usage
暂停背景动画与可视化刷新；回到前台自动恢复: Pauses background and visualizer updates; resumes when focused
后台时仅保留进度条的低频刷新，大幅降低 GPU/CPU 占用: Keeps only low-rate progress updates in the background, greatly reducing GPU/CPU usage
在线搜索封面在内存中的保留数量；超出后释放最旧的纹理: Number of online cover thumbnails kept in memory; oldest textures are released beyond this
频谱/波形的更新频率；30 fps 已足够流畅，降低可减少 CPU 占用: Spectrum/waveform update rate; 30 fps is smooth enough and lowering it reduces CPU usage
透明背景下建议关闭，否则窗口矩形仍会投下一圈系统阴影: Turn this off for a transparent background; otherwise the window rectangle still casts a system shadow
轻负载界面通常核显更省电；强制独显可能因跨显卡合成反而提高占用: For light UI work the integrated GPU is usually more efficient; forcing the discrete GPU can raise usage due to cross-adapter composition
